channel.title: NeuroData AI Summer School blog
channel.description: A one-week residential summer school at HHMI Janelia on reanalysis of open neurophysiology data and AI methods for neural data. Formerly NeuroDataReHack.

item.title: Announcing the NeuroData AI Summer School
item.description: NINDS has awarded a five-year R25 grant to continue and expand NeuroDataReHack as the NeuroData AI Summer School. Here is what the award funds and what changes.
